id.description: Unique identifier for a translation pattern.

name.description: Name given to a translation pattern for an organization.

matchingPattern.description: Matching pattern given to a translation pattern for an organization.

replacementPattern.description: Replacement pattern given to a translation pattern for an organization.

level.description: Level at which the translation pattern is created. The level can either be `Organization` or `Location`.

location.description: Location details for the translation pattern when the level is `Location`.
